why: mv-gang round 1, 1:25 'distracted by a dyspraxic flash'
prompt:
A music-video still at night on a brick bank's back steps in 1920s America, shot head-on as a press photographer's bulb flash fires straight into the lens: a hard white burst blooms over the left of the frame, washing the brick to chalk and throwing a sharp black shadow behind. BOTTLE, a robber in a brown tweed suit, collar up, black leather gloves, stumbles toward camera mid-step, knees buckling, one gloved arm thrown across his head. His mask is a hand-knitted bottle-green rib-wool hood, smooth unbroken knit where the face would be, an oatmeal chain-stitched ring outlining a face, and one small rounded red felt triangle high over his right eye, which sits on the left side of the picture. A canvas sack tumbles from his other glove, banknotes fanning into the air. Speed Graphic look, 35mm wide, frozen motion, harsh frontal flash, coarse grain, blank wall behind.

Thanks.
